flags.text: Edition: the CCEL Confession is the American revision, not the 1646 text. Chapter 23 reads "as nursing fathers, it is the duty of civil magistrates to protect the Church", the 1788 American wording; the 1646 text reads "yet he hath authority, and it is his duty, to take order, that unity and peace be preserved in the Church". The header names no print source. The Larger and Shorter Catechism editions are also unstated.
flags.resolves_by: Acquire the 1646/1647 text from a stated public-domain print: Schaff, Creeds of Christendom vol. III (1877) prints the original with the American changes in notes (CCEL ccel/schaff/creeds3, same CCEL policy), or a fresh transcription from a scanned 1647 or 1658 printing; then record which edition the grammar of B068 cites.

flags.text: Digitization rights: CCEL's edition policy (personal, educational or non-profit use; permission to republish or use commercially) applies to all three files; the confessional texts themselves are public domain.
flags.resolves_by: CCEL permission, or an independently provenanced transcription.
